title: StudentExcusedByTeacher (schemaVersion 1)
description: The teacher excused a student without an approved guardian excuse covering the date, when attendance was taken or corrected to EXCUSED. The reason is not in the payload (free text, KVKK); the guardian reads it through the attendance REST API. Times are the institution's local time (Europe/Istanbul). Consumers: notification (student and guardian: the teacher allowed the absence).
